inputs.text: [excited] It was 2 meters long — [quickly] as long as a motorcycle! Standing up, it was only half a meter tall — [playful] it would come up to your waist! And it weighed 15 kilos — as heavy as a 4-year-old.
[confident] Yes. [amazed] In the movies they show it giant, with no feathers, but the real Velociraptor was covered in feathers, [proud] barely bigger than a big dog.
